utrap_v2.note: lambda=0.15 was inherited from the OLD UTRAP runs, whose inner attacker was a different and much weaker process (ERRATUM_utrap_inner_attacker.md). Parity here is the scale at which grad L_retain and lambda*grad L_target(theta_K) are comparable.

caveat: A gradient-norm ratio gives the scale at which two terms are COMPARABLE. It does not say parity is optimal -- only that a coefficient orders of magnitude from parity cannot be doing what its author intended (FINDING67).
